title: Atziri's Temple: rush to Atziri
summary: Run maps with Temple Tablets for Vaal Beacon Crystals, then spend them in Atziri's Temple on a straight path to Atziri's Chamber. Atziri, the Red Queen drops the lineage support Atziri's Communion.

budget.why: Three Temple Tablets per map, each with the extra-Crystal suffix.
budget.build_needs: Clears the Temple's rooms up to Atziri's Chamber and kills Atziri, the Red Queen.

claim.note: Our reading of the setup against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: No source we cite says how hard Atziri, the Red Queen is in 0.5.5.

complexity.why: Maps feed Crystals into a second activity, the Temple, where rooms are placed and upgraded on the way to Atziri's Chamber.

claim.note: Our reading of the strategy's own steps against the complexity scale; not measured.

durability.why_it_works: Atziri, the Red Queen drops Atziri's Communion, and the Temple is built from Crystals that Temple Tablets' Vaal Beacons pay out.
breaks_when: Vaal Beacon Crystal payouts or Temple room rules are changed

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.

yields.why: Lineage support gem dropped by Atziri, the Red Queen.

claim.note: poe2db: dropped by Atziri, the Red Queen. Both temple creators farm Atziri for it (DEADRABB1T 2:19, Diztoh 17:37).

yields.why: Vaal currency ('Modifies a Corrupted Equipment or Jewel item unpredictably or destroys it') that temple runs pay out.

claim.note: poe2db ties it to Incursion (Vaal) content. DEADRABB1T (22:51) counts Architect's Orbs from his runs; Path of Evening (Xhmh1Tx9eAw, 6:12) says level-3 rooms give such currency deterministically.
No Atlas Master node mentions Vaal Beacons, Crystals, the Temple or Atziri (poe2db node list, checked 2026-10-01), so no master is listed.

mods.text: (5–10)% chance to gain an additional Crystal from Vaal Beacons in Map

waystone.notes: No source we cite ties a waystone total to Vaal Beacons; the tablets are what add them.

claim.note: Our reading: Temple Tablets add the Vaal Beacons, not a waystone total.

steps: Slot up to three Temple Tablets with the extra-Crystal suffix so each map adds Vaal Beacons, and energise them for Crystals (6 per console, store up to 60).
Enter the Temple from its Atlas map, not the Vaal Ruins waypoint: both creators say the waypoint gives a lower-level temple.
Build a straight path to Atziri's Chamber, which unlocks by completing the Royal Access Chamber; keep the Architect's reward rooms on the outer edges.
Lock your level-3 production rooms (Alchemy Lab, Thaumaturge, Altar of Sacrifice, Smithy); a lock is not fully safe.

Kill Atziri, the Red Queen, for Atziri's Communion, about every second temple. Diztoh fights Atziri before the Architect, since killing the Architect destabilises the temple; DEADRABB1T kills both in one run.
risks: Jiquani's Thesis is not an Atziri drop (it comes from a Core Destabiliser on a Soul Core), so it is not in this basket.

The route, the room locks and the Atziri-every-second-run rhythm are creator advice (DEADRABB1T 2026-06-05, 12:52, 15:37, 16:57–17:43, 21:15; Diztoh 2026-09-29, 0:21, 1:37, 6:31; Path of Evening 2026-07-02).
Rooms reach Tier 4 only after you unlock it on the Temple Atlas Tree (poe2db).
